SharePad

SharePad for iPad help

Draw on your iPad and the canvas shows on your Mac over Wi-Fi, ready to share in a call.

Pair with your Mac

On your Mac, click the SharePad icon in the menu bar, then Pair an iPad. On your iPad, tap Scan Code and point the camera at the code. If the camera is off, tap Type the code instead.

Allow screen recording

Each time SharePad connects to your Mac, your iPad asks to record the screen. Tap Allow. Your Mac shows only the canvas. The tools, menus and Settings stay on the iPad.

“Looking for your Mac”

Check that SharePad is open on your Mac, that both are on the same Wi-Fi, and that Allow wireless iPads is on in the SharePad menu on your Mac.

“Local network is off”

Tap Settings next to the message and turn on Local Network for SharePad. Your iPad needs it to find your Mac.

“Screen recording stopped”

iPadOS stopped the recording, for example for a call or a recording you started from Control Centre. Tap Try Again.

Still stuck?

Email hello@sharepad.co and you’ll hear back from a person. Bugs and ideas are welcome as GitHub issues.
